description: This file defines the Header controller class for an OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class generates the data needed to render the website header, including language, styles, scripts, logo, wishlist, navigation links, and other elements. It interacts with configuration, customer, and document objects to assemble the view data.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing header data for the website, including language, title, styles, scripts, logo, wishlist info, user account links, and navigation components.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates and returns the complete header view with dynamically populated data such as language, title, styles, scripts, user info, and navigation links.
